goal: Restore the root homepage as the integrated Orbit Agent plus activity overview instead of an event-only page.

success_criteria.description: GET / renders an Orbit Agent first-viewport section before activity or event sections; route source tests fail if app/page.tsx only delegates to an event-only or personal-home adapter.
The lower root homepage content shows localized activity and event context with links into event and contact workflows, while /app/home and /app/home/events remain the personal home routes.
Regression tests assert the rendered root contains the agent hero marker, the activity overview marker, and does not collapse into a pure My events page.
The root homepage keeps existing no-write live safety behavior and does not add external network calls, notifications, calendar writes, or message sends during render.
The app documentation explains the route boundary between /, /app/home, and /app/home/events so future changes do not repeat the homepage regression.

out_of_scope: Changing /app/home personal hub behavior unless a regression test proves a route boundary requires it
Adding live writes, notifications, message sends, or calendar mutations
